entries.title: Monster Train
entries.definitive_edition: Monster Train on Windows PC with The Last Divinity DLC

emulation.notes: Use the native PC release with The Last Divinity installed; no emulation is needed.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Native Windows PC presentation with complete DLC content.

primary.version: Current PC release with The Last Divinity DLC
primary.why: The Windows PC route is the best archive version because it covers the base game and The Last Divinity expansion while preserving PC capture/settings flexibility. Switch First Class also bundles the DLC and updates, but it does not add sourced platform-exclusive gameplay content over the complete PC route.
primary.how_to_play: Buy Monster Train on Steam or Xbox/Microsoft Store for Windows PC and include The Last Divinity DLC before starting the archive run.

all_releases.fidelity: Native PC release with The Last Divinity DLC available.
all_releases.reason: primary: complete game plus DLC with PC capture/settings flexibility.

all_releases.fidelity: Xbox console and cloud release route.
all_releases.reason: skip: console/cloud route, but no sourced platform-exclusive gameplay content over the complete Windows PC route.

all_releases.fidelity: Monster Train First Class portable console edition bundling the base game, The Last Divinity expansion, and prior updates.
all_releases.reason: skip: very complete portable route, but no sourced platform-exclusive gameplay content over Windows PC with DLC.
skip: mobile route, but no sourced platform-exclusive gameplay content over the complete Windows PC route.
skip: later console route, but no sourced platform-exclusive gameplay content over the complete Windows PC route.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: Switch First Class bundles the DLC, but the complete PC route is available by installing The Last Divinity.

entries.remaster_caveats: Monster Train First Class is a bundled Switch edition, not a separate content-superior version if the PC DLC is installed.
